NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 12:36 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 31.9 DraftKings points for $10,000, at Miami. Kenneth Walker III (26.8, $9,000) and Kyren Williams (21.1, $7,600) are next.

Jahmyr Gibbs is also the top value at the position: 3.19 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 12:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 9

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET at MIA ($10,000)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 31.9 DraftKings points at $10,000, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.1 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 23.0 carries and 5.3 targets. The salary works out to 3.19 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 31.7 points with a simulated floor of 19.0 and a ceiling of 48.3, and he holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 7-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs NYJ ($9,000)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 26.8 DraftKings points at $9,000, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.5 carries and 3.9 targets. The salary works out to 2.98 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 26.7 points with a simulated floor of 14.3 and a ceiling of 43.9, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR at WAS ($7,600)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.1 DraftKings points at $7,600, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 15.6 carries and 4.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.77 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 39.2, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Washington, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Value: Cam Skattebo, NYG at PHI ($5,600)

Cam Skattebo projects for 16.4 DraftKings points at $5,600, which works out to 2.92 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Skattebo averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 33.2, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Giants are a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Philadelphia, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 39.5.
